game.tutorial.title: Kumno ban lehkai .
game.tutorial.quickTap.step1: Nyngkong ngi iohi ia kawei ka dur. Kynmaw ia ka — kane ka dei ka dur ban kem.
game.tutorial.quickTap.step2: Nangta ki dur ki paw kawei hadien kawei hapdeng ka screen.
game.tutorial.quickTap.step3: Ynda phi la iohi ia ka dur jong phi, tap ia ka screen stet.
game.tutorial.quickTap.step4: Na ka bynta kano kano ka dur, wat tap. Ka jingtap ia kiwei pat ki dur ka shim ia ki point.
game.tutorial.pathMatch.step1: Ki circle ba la ai nombar la pynphriang kylleng ka screen.
game.tutorial.pathMatch.step2: Tap ia ka circle 1, nangta circle 2. U lain u pyniasoh ia ki.
game.tutorial.pathMatch.step3: To iaid beit ha ka jingpynbeit — 3, 4, 5 — haduh ba kawei pa kawei ka circle kan iasoh lang.
game.tutorial.pathMatch.step4: Ha ki kyrdan kiba kham halor ka don ka por. Pyndonkam ia ka por jong phi; ka jinglong thikna ka long kaba kongsan tam.
game.tutorial.countingBoxes.step1: Ka stack jong ki synduk ka paw tang katto katne sekhon.
game.tutorial.countingBoxes.step2: Khmih ia kawei pa kawei ka synduk, kynthup ia kiba la buh shadien ne halor.
game.tutorial.countingBoxes.step3: Ynda ki synduk ki la jah, pynrung katno phi la khein.
